Method of Attack: Android malware that detects vulnerable WiFi routers based on their model and changes their DNS settings to hijack DNS and redirect connected devices to malicious web pages hosting phishing forms or dropping Android malware
Uses default router credentials to access admin interface and perform DNS hijacking
Spreads infection by redirecting Android devices connected to compromised WiFi networks to malicious landing pages prompting malware installation
Uses SMS phishing (smishing) to lure targets to malicious websites
Impacted Systems: vulnerable WiFi routers (specific models mainly in South Korea)
Attack Vector: router DNS hijacking via default credentials
